text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That's right! This Kikuka Sho, in No 
Reason-chan's place...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: "I'm! The one who's gonna do itttt!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Well now, Mirako. Care to aim for the 
realm alongside me?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
First up is the final battle of the 
Classic Triple Crown, the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The winner might be me, or it might just 
be you, Mirako!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Me? Even just running in the Kikuka 
Sho is already crazy enough, so...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(No Reason-chan reached out to me... back 
when I didn't have any real track record 
to speak of.)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(She chose me as her training partner, and 
pulled me all the way here. Then—)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I'll give it my all today, for No 
Reason-chan's sake too!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, my goodness! Miracle, miracle, Hishi 
Miracle!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: And the winner of this race is—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: It's meeeeeeeeeee!! Doryaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Whaaat?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...But things didn't go so smoothly. No 
Reason made his move with perfect timing, 
launching into a spurt—"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The winner is No Reason! Shrugging off all 
the talk of being in a slump, she's pulled 
off a stunning upset-!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Nyah-ha-ha-ha! We pulled it off~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh, wha, whaaat...? W-What do you mean, 
No Reason-chan???

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Kuh-kuh-kuh... To reveal my strategy, it's 
quite simple!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Listen well, Trainer. Since they've gone 
to the trouble of falling out with each 
other... There is only one thing left to 
do—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
We shall continue to pretend we are 
feuding like this. Understood?
choice_data_list:
So you're saying you'll keep acting like 
you hate each other?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mm. Normally, an obvious feud like this 
would be seen right through by rival 
camps. However...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
If it seems to stem from a real fight, 
that is a different matter. Everyone will 
likely be fooled completely.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
If we can make them believe "their 
relationship is completely ruined" and 
catch them off guard—they'll fall right 
into our trap.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Let's take them by surprise with an 
unexpected ambush! Nya-ha-ha-ha!
choice_data_list:
The aim of the surprise attack is— 
victory?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, that is not all. With a lack of 
strong rivals this time, expectations for 
the race are likely to be low as well.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
In that case, running normally will not 
make my name known. If so, then!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to show you just how brilliant of 
a strategist I am!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"It's the Satsuki Sho all over again! I'll 
blow everyone's minds so hard they'll 
scream, 'You've gotta be kidding me?!'"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Aaah-uuugh! I was trickedddd!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Don't take it to heart, Mirako! This is 
the Warring States period, surely it was a 
good lesson!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the Kikuka Sho ended in victory 
for No Reason, thanks to a scheme 
well-played.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Well now, Trainer, it went splendidly. 
Truly exhilarating!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, our good showing this time owes 
much to my wicked scheme. However, that 
alone does not account for it.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Well spoken. "If one aims for supremacy, 
one must walk the royal road."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hadst thou not given me thy counsel 
straight, I surely would have lost my way.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: You truly are a good-for-nothing fellow.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Throughout this Classic Triple Crown, you 
truly were a jinx. However...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Through your own sheer determination, you 
managed to cast off all that misfortune.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"That very spirit is the most 
indispensable thing if I am to entrust my 
back to you from here on!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to working with you from 
now on as well. There is truly no one else 
I would rather entrust with my command 
fan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So much has happened to bring us here. It 
wouldn't have been strange if our bond had 
snapped at any point. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having overcome every hurdle of the 
Classic Triple Crown, No Reason and I have 
forged a true bond of general and 
strategist.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And shortly after the Kikuka Sho—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A Tenno Sho Umamusume!! Born right from 
the Classic Class!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Symboli Kris S! It is Symboli Kris S!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Defeating a field of formidable Senior 
Class contenders, she brilliantly claims 
the Shield!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: One debt—repaid. And next—the year-end.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe I can pay back one more thing. At 
the Grand Prix."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
What...!? Trainer, Miracle. Did Kris 
S-dono truly...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that was totally incredible...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Conquering the Tenno Sho (Autumn) in the 
Classic Year. Symboli Kris S has pulled 
off a truly monumental feat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No Reason had worked hard too, but with 
this, the title of the generation's 
strongest...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, we were outsmarted, were 
we...? In that case—we've got no choice 
but to strike back, hmm.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Splendid, splendid. Now there is no doubt 
that Lord Kris S is seen as the strongest 
of her generation. And—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Among the older generation, there's heaps 
of warlords far above our caliber.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. What say you to crossing swords 
with me before the year is out?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
At the year-end spectacle, the Arima 
Kinen. How does that sound?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"By this point in the season, there's 
hardly any difference in build compared to 
Senior Class Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even with No Reason, she can definitely 
do it. She can go toe-to-toe with the 
generation above her."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Um, No Reason-chan, can I... too?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Of course! For you, just like me, are 
striving to rise up from total obscurity, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
You can do it! You can fight! Who 
knows—you might even build an entire era 
of your own!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh, building an era~? Even though I 
can't even do my homework properly~?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, that's beside the point! Behold the 
magnificent ambush of the Usurper 
Sisters~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The Upstart Sisters...? Since when...? But 
still...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, got it...! I want to have a good 
time too, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Hishi Miracle gets dragged into 
it. However, her eyes burn with hope.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two of them headed toward the 
year-end Arima Kinen.
